pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.2: tena kho pana samayena therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadanti pariyāyena. tena kho pana samayena āyasmato cūḷapanthakassa pariyāyo hoti bhikkhuniyo ovadituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.3: bhikkhuniyo evamāhaṃsu: “na dāni ajja ovādo iddho bhavissati taññevadāni udānaṃ ayyo cullapanthako punappunaṃ bhaṇissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.4: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā cullapanthako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ cullapanthakaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmā cullapanthako etadavoca: ‘samaggattha bhaginiyo’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.9: eso bhaginiyo ovādoti nīyādetvā imaṃ udānaṃ punappunaṃ abhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.14: bhikkhuniyo evamāhaṃsu: “nanu avocumhā na dāni ajja ovādo iddho bhavissati taññevadāni udānaṃ ayyā cullapanthako punappunaṃ bhaṇissatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.15: assosi kho āyasmā cullapanthako tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.16: atha kho āyasmā cullapanthako vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamati’pi tiṭṭhati’pi nisīdati’pi seyyampi kappeti dhūmāyatipi pajjalatipi antaradhāyatipi taññeva udānaṃ bhaṇati aññañca bahuṃ buddhavacanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.19: na vata no ito pubbe ovādo evaṃ iddho bhūtapubbo yathā ayyassa cūḷapanthakassāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.20: atha kho āyasmā cullapanthako tā bhikkhuniyo yāva samandhakārā ovaditvā uyyojesi: “gacchatha bhaginiyo”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.21: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo nagaradvāre thakite bahinagare vasitvā kālasseva nagaraṃ pavisanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.22: manussā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti; “abrahmacāriniyo imā bhikkhuniyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.23: ārāme bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ vasitvā idāni nagaraṃ pavisantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.24: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.25: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.26: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā cullapanthako atthaṅgate sūriye bhikkhuniyo ovadissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.27: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ cullapanthaka atthaṅgate sūriye bhikkhuniyo ovadasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.30: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ cullapanthaka atthaṅgate sūriye bhikkhuniyo ovadissasi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.32: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.33.1: “sammatopi ce bhikkhu atthaṅgate suriye bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:2.1.8: aṭṭhahi vā garudhammehi aññena vā dhammena ovadati āpatti pācittiyassa.
